🚨 WAYMO ROBOTAXI DRIVES INTO ONCOMING TRAFFIC IN THE U.S. - EMERGENCY CONTROL ROUTED TO THE PHILIPPINES 

A passenger inside a Waymo self-driving autonomous robotaxi filmed the moment the car entered oncoming traffic on a U.S. road.

When the rider called for help, support answered from the Philippines - attempting to remotely intervene while the driverless car was still moving through traffic.

Control is “escalated.”
The call breaks up.
The operator disappears.

The frustrated passenger eventually says he's getting out and will handle it himself.

A self-driving car.
Wrong-way traffic.
Remote control from the other side of the world.

So who’s really driving these cars - and who else has access?
